_notes: v1.0.0: Grok Build is a first-class agent. Its hook contract matches
snake_case aliases for tool_name / permission_mode / session_id /
notification_type / error). The installed command is therefore the
existing `claude-hook` handler, not a second parser.
setup-hooks writes this file to ~/.grok/hooks/ymux.json. Grok loads
every JSON file in that directory. It also loads ~/.claude/settings.json
when Claude compatibility is on; identical commands run once.
The PreToolUse matcher stays the Claude names. Grok maps Bash/Write/
Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit/Task onto its own tools before matching.
timeout 600 is required: Grok's PreToolUse default is 5s, and the
desktop Gate waits for the human.
SessionStart source `new` / `load` is translated to Claude's `startup`
/ `resume` by the CLI before context.inject, so the Context Rail still
injects. Shell calls arrive as run_terminal_command; the policy engine
judges them as Bash, and the phone forward uses that canonical name
so the daemon's Block half (which only knows Bash) still fires.
